# waiting edges: one local interval per phase-device
        pw = np.arange(P, dtype=np.int64).reshape(P, 1)
        iw = np.arange(N, dtype=np.int64).reshape(1, N)
        self.w_src = (pw * N + iw).reshape(-1)
        self.w_dst = (((pw + 1) % P) * N + iw).reshape(-1)
        self.w_wb = self.vT.T.reshape(-1)
        self.w_wpy = (self.w_wb * AGE_MULT + 1).tolist()
        self.w_kind = np.full(P * N, -1, dtype=np.int64)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    def csr(self, g, want_kind=False):
        """Lineage-graph adjacency for guard ``g`` as python lists."""
        pos = np.nonzero((self.tr_gmax >= g) & self.tr_bl)[0]
        dst = np.concatenate((self.tr_dst[pos], self.w_dst))
        srcg = np.concatenate((self.tr_src[pos], self.w_src))
        posl = pos.tolist()
        del pos
        w = list(map(self.tr_wpy.__getitem__, posl))
        del posl
        w.extend(self.w_wpy)
        cnt = np.bincount(srcg, minlength=self.nstates)
        del srcg
        indptr = np.zeros(self.nstates + 1, dtype=np.int64)
        indptr[1:] = np.cumsum(cnt)
        del cnt
        if want_kind:
            kind = self.tr_kind[np.nonzero((self.tr_gmax >= g) & self.tr_bl)[0]].tolist()
            kind.extend(self.w_kind.tolist())
            return indptr.tolist(), dst.tolist(), w, kind
        return indptr.tolist(), dst.tolist(), w, None
